_comment: Controls the wikiElections homepage. 'mode': 'active' shows the flashing red breaking-news banner and the LIVE results box. 'mode': 'off-cycle' hides both and shows the standard off-cycle masthead. Admins can flip this from /admin/.

liveBox.label: LIVE: Class 6 Election Results
liveBox.text: Watch the results come in real time and find out who's going to be TSR's next moderator.

offCycle.headline: No elections currently underway
offCycle.text: Check back closer to the next TSR moderator or council cycle. Browse ProbCalc and BaseCalc for standing polling averages in the meantime.
